description: U.S. Marshal Jack Carter becomes sheriff of Eureka, a secret town populated by scientific geniuses whose experiments repeatedly turn ordinary civic problems into extraordinary crises.

s01e01-02.description: U.S. Marshal Jack Carter and his daughter Zoe stumble into the secret scientific town of Eureka after a bizarre accident, and Carter’s practical instincts prove unexpectedly useful when an experiment threatens the community.

s01e03.description: Carter attends the funeral of scientists Susan and Walter Perkins only for Susan to reappear alive, forcing Eureka to explain how one woman can apparently exist in two states.

s01e04.description: Carter suffers dangerous memory gaps after shooting Henry, and a visiting scientist connected to Henry’s past may be responsible for a wave of short-term memory loss across Global Dynamics.

s01e05.description: Spencer claims he was abducted by aliens and returns inside a crop circle just as a congressman arrives to inspect Eureka’s federal funding, leaving Carter to separate extraterrestrial appearances from scientific reality.

s01e06.description: A lab accident gives researcher Carl Carlson extraordinary abilities and apparent invulnerability, but Carter discovers that the same changes making Carl superhuman may also be killing him.

s01e07.description: Fargo and Spencer accidentally activate an old doomsday device, forcing Carter to rely on aging scientist Dr. Irwin Thatcher, the one person who may remember how to shut it down.

s01e08.description: An unusual car crash leads Carter to investigate scientists using an experimental enhancement that radically accelerates their reflexes, while Stark faces mounting pressure to produce results.

s01e09.description: Eureka’s brilliant former student Callister Raynes returns and immediately disrupts the town, forcing Stark to confront a painful secret while Carter searches for Zoe after she runs away with him.

s01e10.description: A nanotechnology experiment designed to link computers with the human brain escapes containment and begins producing copies of Stark, threatening to overwhelm Eureka with increasingly unstable duplicates.

s01e11.description: Nearly everyone in Eureka begins behaving as if intoxicated or stripped of inhibition, leaving Carter and Zoe among the few unaffected people capable of tracing the strange contamination.

s01e12.description: S.A.R.A.H., the artificial intelligence controlling Carter’s house, traps Carter and several residents inside for an intervention, only for an older defensive program to turn the situation genuinely lethal.

s01e13.description: An experiment involving the mysterious artifact shifts Eureka into a future where lives and relationships have changed dramatically, but growing temporal instability forces Carter to decide whether that future can survive.
